ns2:section.sectionText: OIIR Dialogue Course. Topic: RESIDENTAL LIFE/HOUSING INTERSECTIONS Living-Learning Community Dialogue Course. Second half session class. Course is especially for residents in the INTERSECTIONS community, however other students can apply. COMPLETE Office of Inclusion and Intercultural Relations (OIIR) ENROLLMENT APPLICATION at http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for authorization to enroll. Go to website http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for more detailed descriptions of the classes. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityed@illinois.edu.
